Top college football predictions for Week 11

One of the top Week 11 college football picks the model is recommending for the best betting apps: 13th-ranked Wake Forest (+1.5, 60.5) covers versus SMU in a noon ET kickoff. Wake is an ACC-best 7-2 ATS, which is also tied for the fifth-best spread record in FBS. The Demon Deacons have won five straight games by 20-plus points, and their only defeat this year came to then-No. 5 Miami, a game in which Wake Forest covered. Meanwhile, SMU has allowed 28-points in back-to-back games, both coming versus ACC teams without winning conference records. Wake Forest covers well over 60% of the time, per 10,000 model simulations.

Another Week 11 prediction: The No. 16 Oregon Ducks (-10.5) win and cover against Michigan in a 3:30 p.m. ET kickoff on Saturday. The Ducks surged back into the CFP conversation in Week 10 with a huge win at Ohio State. It was their second straight win and cover against a ranked team. The Wolverines looked lifeless in a loss to rival Michigan State last week, and don't have much on the line other than salvaging bowl eligibility. SportsLine's model projects that the Ducks win by 16 as they cover well over 60% of the time. The Over 38.5 is also a strong play as that clears well over 70% of the time.
